messages:
alex_k: heads-up — RC3 deployment is blocked waiting on reviewer sign-offs. we need two approvals before we can merge and cut the hotpatch branch. timeline: aiming for deploy by 21:30 PT.

sana: which PR(s)? paste link pls.

alex_k: https://github.com/redwood-inference/infra/pull/4487 and https://github.com/redwood-inference/service/pull/1482 — infra PR is the gating one, service PR is a small fix that must land together.

jorge: i'll pick up infra PR review now, ETA ~25m. can someone run a quick local e2e on the service PR?

lina: running e2e on service PR now — headless run failing on deploy smoke: "timeout while waiting for model server". log snippet:```
[2026-03-17T20:02:13Z] connect timeout to 10.0.2.14:8080 after 30s
[2026-03-17T20:02:13Z] retrying init container
```

ben: QA can validate infra change once jorge posts comments. if e2e keeps failing we should fallback to sidecar bump only and postpone the config change. not ideal but keeps customer impact minimal.

release-bot: CI status — infra PR #4487: checks/pipeline — FAILED (smoke-e2e). service PR #1482: checks/pipeline — SUCCESS. https://ci.redwood-inference.internal/builds/76021

jorge: left review comments on infra PR: small nits + a question about the new healthcheck timeout default. tentative +1 after change.

alex_k: thanks jorge. lina, if you can re-run e2e after increasing timeout to 45s, that would be great. command i'm using locally:```
kubectl -n rc3 set env deploy/model-server HEALTHCHECK_TIMEOUT=45
```

lina: will try that now and report back in ~10m.

qa-bot: tagging @sre-oncall for visibility — production RC window at 21:30 PT.

ben: if we get infra +1 and service already green, i'm happy to do the merge and tag. pls ping once both are approved. :thumbsup:

alex_k: copy — i'll coordinate. if e2e still flakes after timeout bump, we might defer the config change and only merge the non-breaking fixes. i'll post an update in 15m.

lina: re-run complete — e2e passed with HEALTHCHECK_TIMEOUT=45. infra PR CI retriggering now.

release-bot: CI status update — infra PR #4487: checks/pipeline — SUCCESS.

alex_k: great. @jorge @ben can you give final sign-off so i can merge and kick the RC job?

jorge: approved. +1

ben: approved, merging now.

alex_k: merged and release job queued: https://ci.redwood-inference.internal/jobs/rc3-deploy-76045 — target deploy 21:28 PT. thanks everyone for the quick turn. :rocket:
